name: dhdesk
description: A macOS and Windows desktop launcher and runtime manager for DeepSeek Harness.
author: zxg

scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run build:main && npm run build:renderer && npm run copy:static
scripts.runtime:prepare: npm run runtime:prepare:node && npm run runtime:prepare:harness
scripts.package:dir:mac: npm run build && CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --dir --mac -c electron-builder.mac.yml
scripts.package:dmg: npm run build && electron-builder --mac dmg --arm64 -c electron-builder.mac.yml
scripts.package:nsis: npm run build && electron-builder --win nsis --x64 -c electron-builder.win.yml
